title: AI art helped me turn my solo game idea into reality — Miner Survivor
author: Unusual-Pen-1781
selftext:
I’ve always wanted to make my own game, so I decided to take the plunge and build Miner Survivor as a solo indie developer.

It’s a survival strategy game where you manage miners, collect gold, build towers, recruit soldiers, and try to survive until the final second.

AI-generated art helped me turn the idea in my head into something playable, while the game logic and systems were built by me.

If you have a moment, I’d really appreciate you checking it out!

🎮 Steam: [https://store.steampowered.com/app/4897540/Miner\_Survivor/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4897540/Miner_Survivor/)
